players.name: Dre Greenlaw

players.name: Fred Warner
players.comment: Warner tallied 11 tackles (two solo) during San Francisco's win over the Cowboys on Sunday.

players.name: Renardo Green
players.comment: Green (back) was a full participant at practice Thursday.

players.name: Ji'Ayir Brown
players.comment: Brown (ankle) does not carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Vikings in Mexico City.

players.name: Upton Stout
players.comment: questionable

players.name: Eddy Pineiro
players.comment: Pineiro made his only field-goal attempt and went 5-for-5 on PATs during Sunday's 46-40 win over the Cowboys.

players.name: Mike Evans
players.comment: Evans (Achilles) is listed as active Sunday against the Vikings in Mexico City, Matt Barrows of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Keenan Allen
players.comment: Allen brought in five of seven targets for 61 yards in the 49ers' 46-40 win over the Cowboys on Sunday.

players.name: Andrew Van Ginkel
players.comment: Van Ginkel (quadriceps) does not carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the 49ers in Mexico City.

players.name: Eric Wilson
players.comment: Wilson recorded seven tackles (six solo), including 1.0 sacks, during the Vikings' 30-10 win over the Packers in Week 10.

players.name: Blake Cashman
players.comment: Cashman (concussion) does not carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the 49ers in Mexico City.

players.name: Isaiah Rodgers
players.comment: Rodgers (quadriceps) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the 49ers in Mexico City.

players.name: Joshua Metellus
players.comment: Metellus (shoulder) is active for Sunday's game against the Packers.

players.name: Will Reichard
players.comment: Reichard made all three of his field-goal attempts and all three PATs in the Vikings' 30-10 win over the Packers on Sunday.

players.name: Justin Jefferson
players.comment: Jefferson caught nine of 13 targets for 74 yards in Sunday's 30-10 win over the Packers.

players.name: Jordan Addison
players.comment: Head coach Kevin O'Connell said Wednesday that Addison underwent thumb surgery earlier this week and won't be placed on injured reserve, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Jauan Jennings
players.comment: Jennings (calf) practiced in full Wednesday.

players.name: Kirk Cousins
players.comment: Cousins completed 21 of 31 passes for 207 yards and two touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 30-10 win over the Packers. He added 11 rushing yards on three carries.

players.name: T.J. Hockenson
players.comment: Hockenson (wrist) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday night's game against the 49ers.

players.name: Jordan Mason
players.comment: Mason carried the ball 16 times for 59 yards and failed to catch his only target in Sunday's 30-10 win over the Packers.
